evidence_scope: criterion_ids identify relevant comparison views, not proof that a criterion passes. PNGs are unretouched browser captures. Finite samples cannot prove unseen states, source facts or continuous behavior. Keep the original rubric; use needs_review if missing evidence determines the GSB decision.

comparison_limits.not_established: Selection, annotation, event insertion, citation, contradiction and source-focus states are sampled. Images cannot establish identity or consistency of the underlying structured data.
Reading, disclaimers and the 360px reduced-motion annotation-to-summary return flow are sampled; unobserved continuous motion, complete persistence and every interactive state remain unverified.
